description: Source file implementing MIME type support and validation functions for media codecs in the Starboard platform, including support checks for audio and video codecs, key system support, and MIME supportability caching.

methods.name: IsAudioOutputSupported
methods.description: Checks if the platform supports a given audio coding type with specified channels.

methods.name: IsSupportedKeySystem
methods.description: Determines if a given key system supports a specific audio or video codec.

methods.name: IsSupportedAudioCodec
methods.description: Checks if an audio MIME info is supported based on codec, subtype, and platform support.

methods.name: IsSupportedVideoCodec
methods.description: Checks if a video MIME info is supported based on codec, subtype, and platform support.
